ScrollFrame.Name = "ScrollFrame"

ScrollFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1

GridLayout.Parent = ScrollFrame

GridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10) 
GridLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
GridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

local function crearBoton(nombre, funcion, colorFondo, colorTexto)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = nombre
    btn.Parent = ScrollFrame
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = colorFondo or Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 0)
    btn.Text = nombre
    btn.TextColor3 = colorTexto or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.TextSize = 16
    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    btnCorner.Parent = btn
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(funcion)
end

-- --- REGISTRO DE BOTONES ---

crearBoton("Kill", function()
    for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then humanoid.Health = 0 end
        end
    end
end)

            local imagen = Instance.new("ImageLabel", gui)
            imagen.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

            sonido:Play()
            task.delay(9, function() gui:Destroy() sonido:Destroy() end)

end)

crearBoton("Destruir Mapa", function()
    for _, obj in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj:IsDescendantOf(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character) then
            obj.Anchored = false
            obj.CanCollide = true
            obj.Velocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5), -10, math.random(-5,5))
        end
    end
end)

crearBoton("NOOT NOOT", function()
    local idImagen = "rbxassetid://103468574170459"
    task.spawn(function()
        for _, obj in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                for _, cara in pairs({"Front", "Back", "Left", "Right", "Top", "Bottom"}) do
                    local d = Instance.new("Decal", obj)
                    d.Texture = idImagen
                    d.Face = Enum.NormalId[cara]
                end
                if not obj:IsDescendantOf(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character) then obj.Anchored = false end
            end
        end
        while true do
            for i = 1, 500 do
                local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
                explosion.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-1000, 1000), math.random(0, 500), math.random(-1000, 1000))
                explosion.BlastRadius = 100
                explosion.BlastPressure = 10000000
                explosion.Parent = game.Workspace
            end
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))

crearBoton("Caras K00P", function()
    local caraID = "rbxassetid://96196903851338"
    local function aplicarCara(char)
        local head = char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if head then
            local bGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
            bGui.Size = UDim2.new(4, 0, 4, 0)
            bGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
            local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", bGui)
            img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            img.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            img.Image = caraID
        end
    end
    for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then aplicarCara(player.Character) end
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(aplicarCara)
    end
end)

crearBoton("lluvia de pelotas", function()
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            local bola = Instance.new("Part", game.Workspace)
            bola.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            bola.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
            bola.Color = Color3.fromRGB(163, 162, 165)
            local root = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then bola.Position = root.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-70, 70), 130, math.random(-70, 70)) end
            Instance.new("Fire", bola).Size = 25
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)
end, Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))

-- NUEVO BOTÓN SOLICITADO
crearBoton("Lluvia de granada xd", function()
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            local granada = Instance.new("Part", game.Workspace)
            granada.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            granada.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
            granada.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
            granada.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
            local root = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                granada.Position = root.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-100, 100), 150, math.random(-100, 100))
            end
            granada.Touched:Connect(function()
                local ex = Instance.new("Explosion", game.Workspace)
                ex.Position = granada.Position
                ex.BlastRadius = 0 -- Solo visual
                granada:Destroy()
            end)
            task.delay(10, function() if granada then granada:Destroy() end end)
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
    end)
end, Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 0), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0))
